title: Overpayment of Allowances to Volunteer Special Constabulary Officers
what_it_is: Overpayment of Allowances to Volunteer Special Constabulary Officers

sections.label: VSC allowance overpayment questions
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Home Affairs about the cause of overpaid VSC allowances since 2008 and steps to prevent recurrence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs in light of the observation by the Auditor-General's Office that the Singapore Police Force had overpaid $2.63 million in allowances to Volunteer Special Constabulary officers (a) what is the cause for the overpayment to not have been uncovered since 2008; and (b) what steps has the Ministry taken to prevent such overpayment from happening again.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang
sentences.text: asked	 the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what are the special considerations behind the amendment of Regulations under the Police Force Act and retroactively applying them to regularise seven years of overpayments (2008-2015) to Volunteer Special Constabulary officers; (b) what measures are being taken to prevent such control lapses in future; (c) whether the retrospective approvals of the allowances are permitted under the Police Force Act; and (d) whether any action will be taken in respect of the officers who approved the revised allowances despite not being authorised to do so.

sections.label: Number of VSC officers
sections.summary: As of June this year, there were 734 VSC officers.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: As of June this year, there were 734 VSC officers.

sections.label: Extra 80 cents overpayment
sections.summary: The additional 80 cents per hour per officer amounts to about $2.62 million over 2008 to 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The additional 80 cents per hour, per officer, amounts to about $2.62 million over the seven years from 2008 to 2015.

sections.label: Current allowance rate too low
sections.summary: The current quantum of $3.60 an hour is, in the speaker's view, still too low.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The current quantum of $3.60 an hour is, in my view, still too low.

sections.label: Process handled with AGC advice
sections.summary: With no complaint about the amount paid, the matter is process, handled with AGC advice, and officers advised to be careful.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If there is no complaint about the actual amount paid, then the only question is the process.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The matter has been handled with advice from AGC.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And the officers have been advised to be more careful.

sections.label: Correction and allowance rate review
sections.summary: Corrections and processes were done, and a review of the actual allowance rate was requested.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If it can be corrected, it will be corrected, which we have done and taken care of the processes.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Not only have we done that, I have asked for a review of the actual rate of allowance.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If and when the review is completed, we will act according to the review.
